title: NIST WebBook: Formaldehyde is CH2O, molecular weight 30.0260 amu
summary: The NIST Chemistry WebBook lists Formaldehyde as CH2O, molecular weight 30.0260 amu, CAS 50-00-0.
body: The NIST Chemistry WebBook entry for Formaldehyde, CAS Registry Number 50-00-0, lists molecular formula CH2O and molecular weight 30.0260 amu. The same entry's monoisotopic molecular weight is 30.0105647 amu. The IUPAC InChI on the entry is InChI=1S/CH2O/c1-2/h1H2. The molecular weight and the monoisotopic mass are two different fields. This card reports the catalog entry. It does not convert either field into a molar mass in grams, and it does not say that every real sample has that weight. It is also not the standard atomic weight in the NIST isotopic-composition file.
